integrity: The infinite result is proved by reducing every selected set to four matching-index types and checking the exact local alliance inequalities. Exhaustive enumeration for \(3\le n\le9\) is used only as verification of the classification, counting formula, connectivity claim, and small exceptions, not as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The claim is restricted to crown graphs. It does not claim novelty for the definitions of defensive or global alliances, for the complete-bipartite minimum formula, or for the later bivariate defensive-alliance polynomial. Literature searches included the aliases crown graph, complete bipartite graph minus a perfect matching, complete bipartite graph minus a one-factor, and bipartite Kneser \(H(n,1)\); an unindexed equivalent formulation remains a residual risk.
title: Global defensive alliances of crown graphs
